fingerprint.structure: 7 slides: cover (hook + subtitle) → 6 tool-demo slides, one tool per slide, in no particular ranked order. No CTA slide; the caption carries 2 extra ideas as a soft CTA to keep reading.
fingerprint.hook: Value-promise title over a lifestyle photo: `How To Find [outcome] [topic]  [emoji]` / `From A [credibility line]`. States the payoff (trending content ideas) and a credibility tag (social media manager) before showing any tool.
fingerprint.camera_motion: humans + web/app UI screenshots mixed. Slide 1: a high-angle lifestyle photo, someone reclined on a couch holding a phone up (selfie-style but the phone doubles as a prop, not framing this shot), a laptop showing a blurred calendar app visible beside them, a creator watermark bottom-left. Slides 2-7: a real laptop screen photographed at a low angle from the keyboard, each showing a different website loaded full-screen, the same calendar app faintly visible behind/around the laptop each time (a consistent desk setup, reused across slides).
fingerprint.pacing: 7 slides, 2 short text lines per slide (a heading and a one-line subheading at the bottom), quick to read; built for a swipe-through.
fingerprint.text_overlay: TikTok Classic on every slide: white with a thick black outline, the heading top-left in Title Case with a trailing emoji, a one-line subheading bottom-center, smaller and in Title Case with occasional lowercase asides and an emoji.
fingerprint.audio: a trending sped-up pop song, music only, not the creator's voice.
fingerprint.arc: A trusted-expert listicle: the cover promises a payoff, then each slide is proof (a real screenshot of a free tool), ending without a hard sell; the caption adds 2 more ideas as a soft continue-reading hook.
